scope: CPU tokenizer/data-preprocessing reconstruction only; no model/session/quantization/activation calibration was executed

summary.mask_policy: valid tokens=1; right padding=0; padding labels=-100

hash_encoding: SHA256 of concatenated signed int64 little-endian token IDs

interpretation.formatting_cause: Recipe add_special_tokens=true makes installed Olive get_text return f"{tokenizer.bos_token} {text} {tokenizer.eos_token}". tokenizer.bos_token is None, so this inserts literal None plus space before the original prompt, then space plus EOS after it. The later tokenizer call uses add_special_tokens=false, so these are already in the rendered text.
interpretation.comparison_to_gptq: GPTQ JOIN used raw prompts with add_special_tokens=false and separators. Activation line-by-line uses all256 original prompts but adds a textual wrapper. No raw-tokenizer drift from the frozen IDs was observed in Transformers5.3.
interpretation.qualification_limit: This establishes preprocessing/input coverage, not quality or completion of the currently running activation calibration. Any future strict token-parity policy requires an explicit recipe change and revalidation, not alteration of tokenizer files or implicit regex flags.

future_policy_consequences.activation_wrapper_only: Changing the supported activation add_special_tokens parameter to False removes the entire wrapper and restores strict frozen-ID parity. It does not change the GPTQ input policy or require repeating GPTQ. It requires repeating activation quantization/calibration and evaluation before qualification.
future_policy_consequences.gptq_join_tail: Retaining the final1881-token JOIN tail changes GPTQ inputs/weights and therefore requires repeating GPTQ, activation quantization/calibration and evaluation. This is separate from the activation wrapper policy.
future_policy_consequences.quality_causality: No quality threshold, quality effect or causal claim is established by this tokenization audit.
future_policy_consequences.current_jobs: No recipe, tokenizer, cache, model or job was changed/restarted.

historical_evidence.scope_limit: This is a deterministic recipe reconstruction, not evidence that running ONNX calibration consumed all samples or runtime IDs/hashes; historical progress/counts must be reported separately.
